title: A-500 assembly & design review
registerRevision: 2026-09-10 · Physical equipment ownership and complete Explore assemblies
lead: TLGO sonication: conditioning tank T-501, circulation pump P-501, inline sonication US-501 (modelled as three cells), loop cooler E-501 (register HX-501), accepted-product transfer pump P-502 and the utilities / A-600 outlet battery limit BL-A500.

findings.topic: Sonication acceptance criterion and dose window
findings.status: Not defined — gating item for A-500
findings.reason: Without a measurable acceptance criterion no dose, pass count, acoustic power, loop flow or cooler duty can be set.
findings.observation: REP-024 records the acceptance criterion as NOT DEFINED (RED): "fully sonicated" must be replaced by a layer-count / thickness (AFM), lateral-size PSD, viscosity or turbidity proxy. D-A500-01 therefore withdrew cumulative dose, dose per pass, pass count (N ≈ 3–5 illustrative), slurry flow, specific energy, residence time and acoustic power (29–573 kW across the plausible window); the HX-501 duty equals installed acoustic power and cannot be fixed either. D-A500-03 approved the requirement itself and the technology benchmark (HPH, rotor-stator, no treatment at equal kJ/kg) before the unit count is frozen.
findings.action: Run the REP-024 §12 bridging program on TLGO at design concentration — dose–response map, acceptance criterion and dose window (D_total, D_v, N), loop RTD test, technology benchmark — then size US-501, P-501 and HX-501 and close A-500 by MoC (D-A500-03 decision gate).

findings.reason: The equipment arrangement must match the process concept: a recirculation loop with dose accounting, not a single-pass flow cell.
findings.observation: D-A500-03 adopts REP-024 §11: US-501 is a dose-controlled cavitation loop T-501 / P-501 / US-501 / HX-501 with N ≥ 3 turnovers, inter-pass cooling and forward transfer gated on dose accounting or an online proxy. The PFD-0500 recirculation line 507, the vendor-specified backpressure and flow, the start-up / maintenance bypass and the 30–40 °C outlet control to A-600 are approved (D-A500-02); T-501 is the surge / hold at the batch-to-continuous boundary (DBM V2.0 §3.4). The model shows the loop with three cells and the cooler in line.
findings.action: Carry the loop concept into the P&ID (line 507 as a process line, dose accounting instrumentation in LST-007, transfer permissive) and derive the 30–40 °C limit from a measured thermal / sonochemical stability test instead of the unstated PFD origin.

findings.topic: Solids concentration and commercial design basis
findings.status: PFD basis approved — MDL-001 basis withdrawn
findings.reason: Loop flow, cell count and cooler duty scale with the solids concentration and the GO rate.
findings.observation: Approved: T-501 agitated at 1–2 wt% TLGO with no water or DMF added (PFD-0500 General Note 1, D-A500-02); REP-024 Lever 2 (run at the highest concentration the TFF delivers) is carried as the optimisation direction. Withdrawn: the MDL-001 basis of 64.98 / 103.97 kg/h GO solids and 5 kW per 10 kg pilot, which predates DBM V2.0 (D-A500-01). The Narrative (PRD-001 §4.10) still carries a DMF line.
findings.action: MoC on FEED-PE-PRD-001 §4.10 and the capacity table: exclude DMF and state one solids-concentration basis shared by A-400 / A-500 / A-600; re-derive the A-500 rates from DBM V2.0 Table 3.3-1.

findings.reason: Wetted materials and sonotrode wear set the product-metal budget of the final rGO.
findings.observation: D-A500-MOC applies MAT-002: PVDF process-wetted envelope, or 316L electropolished where the product-metal budget allows, for T-501 / P-501 / HX-501 / E-501; MDL-001 (HDPE / XLPE tank, 316L pump and tubes) superseded. D-A500-03 approves the sonotrode as Ti Grade 5 (MAT-002 M-035) with a defined tip-replacement interval; REP-024's erosion / Ti-pickup bound is carried in the note. US-501 itself has an MDL-001 material only and stays candidate until MAT-002 covers it.
findings.action: Set Ti / Fe / Cr limits in FEED-QA-SPC-001 and a tip-replacement schedule from measured sonotrode mass loss (REP-024 §12); extend MAT-002 to the US-501 cell body.

findings.reason: Every equipment item in the area must have one identity in the register, the model and the data layer.
findings.observation: Three LST-001 tags (T-501, P-501, US-501) are bound to model geometry. The loop cooler is HX-501 in LST-001, PFD-0500, MAT-002 M-036 and MDL-001 but E-501 in the model (equipment 66) — same equipment, two tags. The model also owns P-502 (accepted-product transfer), BL-A500 and fire point FE-501, none on LST-001 / PFD-0500, and five interface records (CIP supply / return, sample, relief, drain) without destinations. LST-001 lists one US-501 flow cell; the model shows three cells.
findings.action: Re-tag model equipment 66 to HX-501 or add E-501 to LST-001 by MoC; add P-502 and BL-A500 to PFD-0500 / LST-001; assign destinations to the five interfaces; record the cell count as open until the REP-024 program fixes N.

findings.status: Intent approved — detail on P&ID / HAZOP
findings.reason: A cavitation unit needs acoustic and vibration containment, a maintenance bypass and interlocked enclosure access.
findings.observation: D-A500-03 approves the safeguard intent: acoustic shielding, vibration isolation, maintenance bypass and enclosure interlocks as drawn (REP-024). The model places fire point FE-501 at the operator approach. Relief (IF-A500-RELIEF) and drain destinations, and the CIP supply / return interfaces, are not yet assigned; LST-007 carries only conceptual loop entries for A-500.
findings.action: Define the enclosure interlocks, relief case and CIP chemistry on the P&ID; confirm the operator approach and fire-point position in the plant-wide access review; complete the A-500 loops in LST-007 once the dose instrumentation is chosen.

findings.topic: Equipment datasheets — T-501, loop pump P-501 and transfer pump P-502
findings.status: Preliminary datasheets issued — US-501 and HX-501 still held
findings.reason: With the A-400 product fixed (8.21 m³/h at 1 wt %, FEED-PE-CAL-022) and the loop concept adopted (D-A500-03), the tank and pumps that do not depend on the dose could be sized; ten A-500 values were open as missing values.
findings.observation: FEED-PE-CAL-023 V1.0 applies the bases approved in review (U1–U4): 82.5 kg/h TLGO at 1 wt % = 8.21 m³/h. FEED-PE-DAT-058: T-501 2 h hold-up as the DBM surge and the loop mixing volume = 16.4 m³ working, 22 m³, agitated closed-vented atmospheric, submerged returns (no air entrainment). FEED-PE-DAT-059: P-501 budgeted at N = 5 turnovers (REP-024 3–5) = 41 m³/h → 45 m³/h rated × 69 m (5 barg at the cells + 0.5 bar HX-501, DN150 at 1,000 mPa·s), 24.3 kW shaft, 30 kW VSD. FEED-PE-DAT-060: P-502 accepted-product transfer 9 m³/h × 18 m (proposed tag and material). 69 candidate rows, none approved; all ten A-500 missing-value gaps close. US-501 and HX-501 / E-501 are not issued: their size follows the dose window D-A500-01 holds (≈ 46–115 kW at 20–50 J/mL on this flow, for scale only).
findings.action: Run the REP-024 §12 bridging programme (dose window, acceptance criterion, loop RTD) — it sets N and re-rates P-501 — and obtain the cell backpressure from the US-501 vendor; measure slurry rheology (with A-400 W2); resolve HX-501 / E-501, register P-502 and add it to MAT-002.

decisions.rationale: No acceptance criterion exists for sonication (REP-024 RED item), so cumulative dose, dose per pass, pass count and therefore acoustic power (29–573 kW across the plausible window) cannot be set. No value approved.
